TIRUPATI TRAVEL PLANNING

Tirupati tour packages.

Compare real trip options from our Tirupati / Renigunta team. Read the stops, choose a vehicle and ask the owner to confirm your arrangements.

What is the package cost?

The cost depends on your chosen trip, travel date, group size, vehicle and accommodation preference. Send these details to Heavenly Tours & Travels on WhatsApp. Owner Hemanth Kumar will share a quotation and explain what is included before you confirm your booking.

Choose a trip that fits your visit

For a short visit, read the Express Package. Families can compare the Govindham Package with the complete seven-temple trip. Longer routes include Vellore and the South India temple tour. The stops are listed on each trip page.

What to share for a quotation

  • Your travel date or flexible dates
  • Arrival and pickup place
  • Number of travellers and luggage needs
  • Preferred trip and vehicle
  • Deluxe (Budget), Exclusive or Premium accommodation preference

The owner confirms what the quote covers and any additional arrangements. Selecting a trip on the website does not reserve a vehicle or room.

Talk to the ownerCall +91 97001 81493

Which trip should I choose?

A short visit
Express Package: arrival pickup, Tirumala transport and return drop; local visits depend on available time.
A family temple trip
Govindham Package: Tirupati, Tirumala, Padmavathi Temple, Govindaraja Swamy Temple and Kapila Theertham.
All seven temples
Complete 7-Temple Trip: all seven listed stops, including Vellore, Kanchipuram and Tiruvannamalai. Ask the owner to plan the number of days.
A fixed number of days
One-to-five-day plans: open each trip for its stops and day-by-day route. The one-day plan requires an already-booked darshan ticket.

Share both your arrival and return times. Confirm the pickup point, final drop, hotel nights and temple visit order before agreeing your plan.
